name: standup-draft
description: Drafts your daily stand-up from the work you already did. Local-first: git, IDE activity and GitHub become a Done / Next / Blockers update, written by a local model or your own API key.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Standup Draft reads real repository history and local editor activity, which virtual workspaces do not provide.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Standup Draft runs git commands in the workspace and records local activity, so it requires a trusted workspace.

commands.title: Standup Draft: Set API Key (Bring Your Own)
Standup Draft: Rate on the Marketplace

standupDraft.lookbackHours.description: How many hours back to gather activity when generating a stand-up.

standupDraft.ollama.url.description: Base URL of your local Ollama server.

standupDraft.ollama.model.description: Ollama model to use for summarizing your activity.

standupDraft.ollama.numPredict.markdownDescription: Maximum tokens the model may generate. `0` (default) uses the per-detail budget (400/900/1600). Raise this if a reasoning model returns nothing.

standupDraft.ollama.numCtx.description: Context window size (tokens) passed to Ollama. Raise it on busy days if your activity is being cut off.

enumDescriptions: Let the model decide; if it returns nothing, Standup Draft retries once with thinking disabled and a larger budget
Always enable reasoning (think: true)
Always disable reasoning (think: false)
standupDraft.ollama.think.markdownDescription: Control reasoning ('thinking') models such as gpt-oss or deepseek-r1.

enumDescriptions: Use a configured API provider if there is one, otherwise Ollama
Bundled local model (not included in the 0.1.x beta)
Use the configured provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or OpenAI-compatible)
Use the local Ollama server
standupDraft.model.backend.markdownDescription: Which engine writes your stand-up. `auto` never falls back silently between hosted providers; with no provider configured it uses Ollama.

enumDescriptions: No API provider configured
Anthropic (Claude)
OpenAI
Google Gemini
Any endpoint that speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions API — OpenRouter, Groq, Together, LM Studio, llama.cpp
standupDraft.provider.type.description: API provider used when standupDraft.model.backend is 'provider' or 'auto'.

standupDraft.provider.model.markdownDescription: Model id for the configured provider (for example `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `gpt-4o-mini`, `gemini-2.5-flash`). Run **Standup Draft: Set API Key** to pick from the provider's model list.

standupDraft.provider.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Endpoint base URL for `openai-compatible` providers, e.g. `http://localhost:1234/v1` or `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`. Paths should not include `/chat/completions`.

standupDraft.provider.maxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Hard cap on tokens the provider may generate. `0` uses the per-detail budget (400/900/1600); a positive value caps it with `Math.min`. If a thinking model returns no answer because it spent the budget on reasoning, Standup Draft retries once with a larger budget (at least 4096) and thinking disabled.

standupDraft.github.useBuiltInAuth.markdownDescription: Use the editor's built-in GitHub sign-in instead of a manual token. No PAT needed — run 'Standup Draft: Connect GitHub' once. Ignored if `standupDraft.github.token` is set.

standupDraft.github.token.markdownDescription: Optional GitHub personal access token. Only needed if you prefer NOT to use built-in sign-in (e.g. headless use). Leave empty to use built-in auth.

standupDraft.github.repos.markdownDescription: Repos to check, as `owner/name`. If empty, Standup Draft auto-detects from the current workspace's git `origin` remote.

enumDescriptions: Only activity from the folders open in this window (default)
Activity from all projects you worked on today, across every workspace
standupDraft.scope.description: Which activity a generated stand-up includes. 'workspace' keeps each project's stand-up clean; 'all' combines your whole day.

enumDescriptions: 3-4 short points, outcomes only
5-7 points with the key specifics (files, endpoints, issue numbers)
6-9 thorough points enumerating files, assets, fields and URLs — a full work log
standupDraft.detail.description: How detailed the generated stand-up should be. Also switchable from the stand-up panel.

enumDescriptions: Default voice — no styling added
Mentions what you learned and where you asked for help
Plain and factual, with brief reasoning
Leads with impact and decisions; terse
standupDraft.tone.description: Voice of the generated stand-up. Also switchable from the stand-up panel.

standupDraft.track.enabled.description: Track IDE activity (which files you edit and save). Stored locally only.

standupDraft.generate.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Abort stand-up generation after this many seconds (a Cancel button is always available too). `0` disables the timeout.

standupDraft.model.contextTokens.markdownDescription: Context window (tokens) for the local model; also the context budget estimate for BYOK providers. Ollama uses `standupDraft.ollama.numCtx`.

standupDraft.feedback.enabled.markdownDescription: Allow the occasional (once per version) feedback prompt after a few successful drafts. Panel thumbs and the feedback commands always work regardless.

standupDraft.feedback.promptAfter.description: How many successful drafts trigger the one-time-per-version feedback prompt.

standupDraft.store.retentionDays.markdownDescription: Delete locally stored activity logs older than this many days on startup. `0` keeps them forever.

standupDraft.reminder.enabled.description: Show a daily local-time notification reminding you to send your stand-up.

standupDraft.reminder.time.markdownDescription: Daily reminder time in 24h `HH:MM`, local time. Set on first run; change any time here or via 'Standup Draft: Set Reminder Time'.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run clean && npm run compile
